title: Improve Dedicated autoscaler: burst controls and utilization reporting enhancement
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Customers running Dedicated fleets reported intermittent inability to sustain short-lived traffic spikes and poor visibility into burst consumption. Motivation: make burst controls more predictable and add clearer utilization reporting for ops and billing. This PR updates the dedicated autoscaler to: 1) add configurable burst token bucket smoothing (burst_smoothing_ms) to avoid immediate token depletion on concurrent spikes; 2) expose per-fleet burst consumption metrics and token-bucket state via the telemetry pipeline; 3) add throughput guarantee labels and SLO flags to help routing and dashboarding. Design summary: - Introduce burst_smoothing_ms and smoothing_factor in the autoscaler config; smoothing decays token withdrawal events across a short sliding window to reduce simultaneous drains. - Emit new metrics: dedicated.fleet.burst_tokens_available, dedicated.fleet.burst_tokens_consumed, dedicated.fleet.burst_smoothing_active, and dedicated.fleet.throughput_guarantee. Metrics follow the existing telemetry tagging scheme (org_id, fleet_id, region, model_family). - Update autoscaler state endpoint (/internal/autoscaler/state) to include token-bucket snapshot for debugging (read-only, auth-protected). - Add migration path: config default preserves previous behavior (burst_smoothing_ms=0). Rollout plan: staged rollout by fleet: default off, enable for a subset of fleets by config flag, monitor error budget and latency p95 for 1 week, then enable wider. Tests: unit tests for token bucket smoothing math and metric emission, integration test that simulates concurrent spike and verifies reduced simultaneous token drains and improved 95th pct latency tail. Checklist: - [x] Config parsing and defaults - [x] Token-bucket smoothing implementation - [x] Metrics emission + tags - [x] State endpoint snapshot - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs and release notes - [x] Add feature flag for staged rollout Related: Linear ENG-6721, ENG-6840; Incident SUP-4582 triggered the original spike report. This description contains implementation notes, testing summary, and rollout guidance.
